title: Fueled by Sean Payton's 'disrespect,' 49ers' Dre Greenlaw dominates Broncos and lets former coach know

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Fueled by Sean Payton's 'disrespect,' 49ers' Dre Greenlaw dominates Broncos and lets former coach know
sources.description: The linebacker led San Francisco with 12 tackles in Sunday's win before opening up about feeling ignored and disrespected during his lone season in Denver
